summary.motive: Build an interior blocking tunnel between the guards, shovel the ball to a full-speed crossing receiver at its mouth, and outrun a defense that triggered on run and false-screen looks.
summary.keyDefender: 3-technique Defensive Tackle (rush lane vs shovel window)
summary.whyItWorks: The 3T must pick between maintaining his rush lane and closing the shovel window — RG’s hinge makes the choice impossible — while the RB swing fake and TE false screen remove both linebackers and the NICKEL from the exact geometry where the tunnel bursts.
summary.failureMode: A 3T who spurns the rush to sit on the window meets Z before the shovel lands, and a WILL who ignores the swing fake scrapes clean into the tunnel — penetration plus disciplined scraping kills the play at birth.

beats.title: 1. Protection Sell, Interior Fire
beats.text: Both tackles take real pass sets while the center snaps down and the LG fires into the B-gap — the front reads pure drop-back. The tunnel opens before anyone sniffs screen.

beats.title: 2. The Tunnel Forms
beats.text: H crosses behind the line and enters the guard-to-guard window first, becoming the lead blocker. The center has NT walled and RG is hinging 3T outside — the shovel window is fully built.

beats.title: 3. Shovel Timing
beats.text: Z catches the underhand flip at the tunnel mouth at nearly full crossing speed. The 3T peeks inside exactly one beat too long — his rush lane and the closing window are the same real estate, and he cannot take both.

beats.title: 4. Misdirection Pays Twice
beats.text: WILL bit on the RB swing fake and NICKEL drifted to the TE’s false flat screen — the two fastest triggers on the defense are both blocked or screened. The MIKE who triggered correctly runs into the LG’s climb.

beats.title: 5. Break Through the Second Level
beats.text: Z bursts vertically behind the LG escort with only the FS holding a legitimate angle. The robber SS arrives into a wall instead of a tackle window — classic shovel geometry.

relations.tell: H crosses behind the line and disappears between the two guards while Z sprints under the formation — nobody runs a route beyond eight yards.
